asset: The morning after the five-minute Space
role: Original cinematic marketing world art for CT Life, not a gameplay capture.

source_versions.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: original panoramic CT Life website world-chapter illustration, landscape 16:9.
Input image: the supplied CT Life studio picture is a STYLE and CHARACTER CONTINUITY reference only. Preserve its crafted planar, cel-shaded 3D game key-art language and the tired angular original green frog moderator with professional headphones. Create a completely new exterior morning composition, not another studio portrait.

Primary scene: It is 6 a.m. in a charming, dense, walkable brick-and-glass CT neighborhood after overnight rain. The night-long social-audio session has finally ended. A tired original frog moderator still wearing the same large headphones quietly pedals a practical everyday bicycle away from the small glass-fronted studio. Across the street, one small adult human builder is rolling up the shutter of an open street-level workshop for the new day. This is one dry, specific city-morning story: one person is finally going home as another starts work.

Composition: Wide street-level cinematic view looking across and along the neighborhood. Environment occupies about 80% of the picture. Both characters are small relative to the architecture but have readable actions and silhouettes; no hero ensemble and no giant faces. The bicycle rider sits in the lower central foreground, fully visible wheels and plausible pedaling anatomy, heading toward the right. Compact café frontage, studio window and workshop establish a connected actual street. A beautiful pink-blossom tree punctuates the center/left streetscape; brick upper floors, clean glass, stoops, warm windows, roof silhouettes and a receding side street create layered urban depth. Central overall city composition works as a complete wide image on mobile without cropping. Leave only the bottom-left approximately 10% of the image visually quiet for a small future HTML caption strip; do not draw that strip or a large blank copy panel.

Lighting: Warm peach sunrise grazes the upper façades and catches puddle reflections against cool blue street shadows. Wet pavement from overnight rain, a few delicate fallen pink petals, gentle dawn atmosphere, rich but controlled color separation. No rain falling now. Lonely funny relief after too much online talk, not generic cheerful lifestyle advertising.

Rendering: Excellent polished authored 3D GAME KEY ART with adult Sims-like stylized-realism proportions, bold graphic light and shadow planes, subtly textured tactile brick/cloth/metal, carefully modeled storefronts and believable urban scale. Match the reference's selective illustrated contours, sculptural forms and deliberate detail, translated from night interior to dawn exterior. Crisp coherent architecture and readable street-level story. Not photoreal photography, not glossy plastic toy city, not chibi, not flat vector cartoon.

Constraints: Original fictional world and characters only. No logos, readable sign text, lettering, numbers, coins, trading charts, money, brands, real people or recognizable copyrighted meme character. Blank/signless shop fascia is fine; identify spaces through architecture and props. No futuristic military, weapons, helmets, floating UI, watermark or raster caption. Keep image opaque. Entire canvas is the original scene.

reference.role: Original CT Life studio artwork used only for crafted planar/cel-shaded 3D style and original frog moderator continuity. Viewed before generation.
reference.boundary: No Marathon artwork, trademark, screenshot, font or asset supplied. Marathon is the website composition reference, not the image source.

inspection.observed: Wide brick-and-glass neighborhood at dawn after rain, pink blossom tree, glass-fronted empty audio studio, original exhausted headphone-wearing frog cycling, adult builder opening workshop shutter. Warm peach sunlight and cool blue shadows. No raster writing or visible third-party logos, trading charts, coins, game UI or watermark.
inspection.limits: Concept artwork does not establish that this location, cast, visual fidelity or connected voice experience exists in the Unity game. User creative acceptance and in-page composition review remain separate.
inspection.mobile: Export preserves the complete wide scene. The rider and workshop remain distinguishable at 640px; use a full-width image rather than a portrait cover crop.

export: cwebp -q 86 -m 6 -resize WIDTH 0. Ordinary responsive size/format conversion only; no crop, compositing, geometry or raster-content changes after generation.
unchanged: Approved CT logo, hero-space assets, website HTML/CSS/JS, Unity/game/backend source.
